selection_reason: S002 provides Wishbone slave/master IO ports and widths needed to declare internal wires connecting top-level WBs to sub-modules.
S003 provides SDC IO ports required for internal declarations of SD command and data signals.
S004 provides optional IO ports (e.g., interrupt pins) and conditions that influence signal declarations.
S006 lists all sub-module port lists and widths, essential for declaring the interconnection wires used by other blocks.
S002 defines top-level Wishbone slave/master ports that must be connected to sd_controller_wb instance.
S003 defines top-level SDC IO ports that must be connected to sd_cmd_serial_host and sd_data_serial_host instances.
S004 defines optional IO ports (e.g., interrupt outputs) whose connectivity to sub-module outputs must be established.
S006 provides the exact port lists of all child modules, necessary to write correct instantiation and wiring.
S006 supplies the sub-module output signals (e.g., free_rx_bd, free_tx_bd, STATUS_REG, NORMAL_INT_REG, etc.) that are assembled.
S007 specifies the Register Update table with the exact combinatorial mapping for Bd_status_reg, status_reg bits, normal_int_status_reg, error_int_status_reg, and Bd_isr_reg.
S002 defines the top-level master Wishbone output ports that the mux drives.
S006 provides the master Wishbone output ports of sd_fifo_tx_filler and sd_fifo_rx_filler, which are the mux inputs.
S008 describes the mux control logic based on start_tx_fifo/start_rx_fifo and the constant assignment for m_wb_sel_o.
S003 defines the interrupt output pins (int_a, int_b, int_c) and their triggering conditions using status and enable registers.
S004 specifies that these interrupts are gated by the SDC_IRQ_ENABLE define, which is needed for the conditional generation logic.
S008 details the reset combination logic: internal reset = wb_rst_i || software_reset_reg[0], and sd_cmd_serial_host reset also includes go_idle_o.
S009 specifies the clock source selection based on SDC_CLK_BUS_CLK and SDC_CLK_DYNAMIC defines, and the mapping of sd_clk_o_pad.
